Class LlamaCppLlmService

java.lang.Object
org.casserole.llm.LlamaCppLlmService
All Implemented Interfaces:
LlmProvider
@Component public class LlamaCppLlmService extends Object implements LlmProvider
The LlamaCppLlmService class is the llama.cpp backend for one chat completion. The class implements LlmProvider. The id is llama-openapi. The chat URL is the base URL plus /v1/chat/completions. Every body includes model. An empty model throws GrokLlmService.NoModelException before the POST. The connect timeout is 10 seconds. The chat timeout is 120 seconds. A blank API key omits Authorization. The provider does not start llama-server. The provider does not download a model.

    • completeFor

      public org.springframework.ai.chat.model.ChatResponse completeFor(String model, org.springframework.ai.chat.prompt.Prompt prompt, LlamaCppCallOptions options, GrokLlmService.HttpSlot slot, GrokLlmService.DeltaSink sink) throws Exception
      The completeFor method sends one chat completion. An empty model throws GrokLlmService.NoModelException before the POST. A null sink sends stream false and reads choices[0].message.content. A non-null sink sends stream true and appends delta.content. A status outside 2xx throws GrokLlmService.StatusException. Empty assistant text throws an exception with the message llama empty content.
      Parameters:
      model - The model is the id after llama-openapi/.
      prompt - The prompt supplies getInstructions().
      options - The options are the set fields. A null value sends no extra fields.
      slot - The slot receives the HTTP future. A null slot skips that store.
      sink - The sink receives kind c. A null sink is the one-shot call.
      Returns:
      The return value is the completion.
      Throws:
      Exception - The method throws this exception for an empty model, an empty prompt, or a failed call.

    • requestBody

      public static String requestBody(String model, List<org.springframework.ai.chat.messages.Message> messages, LlamaCppCallOptions options, boolean stream) throws Exception
      The requestBody method builds the completion JSON. model is always written. A null message list throws an exception with the message llama empty prompt. A null message, a null message type, or a role other than system, user, or assistant throws an exception with the message llama unknown role. A null message text is stored as an empty string. Unset option fields stay off the body.
      Parameters:
      model - The model is the model id.
      messages - The messages are the prompt instructions.
      options - The options are the set fields. A null value adds no extra fields.
      stream - The flag is true when a sink is attached.
      Returns:
      The return value is the JSON body.
      Throws:
      Exception - The method throws this exception for an empty prompt or an unknown role.

    • catalogText

      public static String catalogText(String body)
      The catalogText method builds a llama_models_result: body from one models document. The alias passed onward is blank. A blank alias leaves each id unchanged.
      Parameters:
      body - The body is the GET /v1/models text.
      Returns:
      The return value is the catalog reply.

    • catalogText

      public static String catalogText(String body, String alias)
      The catalogText method builds a llama_models_result: body from one models document. A null body returns the header only. A body that is not JSON returns the header only. A missing data array returns the header only. Each textual non-empty data[].id becomes one model: line. A path-shaped id becomes the trimmed alias when that alias is non-blank. A repeated name is one line. Reply order is kept. An empty id is skipped.
      Parameters:
      body - The body is the GET /v1/models text.
      alias - The alias replaces a path-shaped id. A null alias is blank.
      Returns:
      The return value is the catalog reply.

    • applyTemplateBody

      public static String applyTemplateBody(List<org.springframework.ai.chat.messages.Message> messages) throws Exception
      The applyTemplateBody method writes one apply-template document. The document has one field, messages. Each message writes role and content. A null message list throws an exception with the message llama empty prompt. A null message, a null message type, or a role other than system, user, or assistant throws an exception with the message llama unknown role. A null message text is stored as an empty string. The method does not open a socket.
      Parameters:
      messages - The messages are the prompt. The value may be null.
      Returns:
      The return value is the JSON body.
      Throws:
      Exception - The method throws this exception for an empty prompt or an unknown role.

    • pathShaped

      public static boolean pathShaped(String id)
      The pathShaped method reports whether a model id is a file path. A null id is not a path. An id that contains / is a path. An id that contains \ is a path. An id that ends with .gguf is a path. The suffix compare ignores case.
      Parameters:
      id - The id is the catalog model id. The value may be null.
      Returns:
      The return value is true when the id is path-shaped.

      The completeOnce method sends the request and reads one JSON body. When the slot is present, the HTTP future is stored on it before the wait. A status outside 2xx throws GrokLlmService.StatusException. Empty assistant content throws an exception with the message llama empty content.

    • completeStream

      private org.springframework.ai.chat.model.ChatResponse completeStream(HttpRequest request, GrokLlmService.HttpSlot slot, GrokLlmService.DeltaSink sink) throws Exception
      The completeStream method sends the request and reads server-sent lines. When the slot is present, the HTTP future is stored on it before the wait. A status outside 2xx throws GrokLlmService.StatusException. Only delta.content is appended. Empty joined content throws an exception with the message llama empty content.
      Parameters:
      request - The request is the POST to send.
      slot - The slot receives the HTTP future. A null slot skips that store.
      sink - The sink receives kind c.
      Returns:
      The return value is the completion whose text is the joined content.
      Throws:
      Exception - The method throws this exception when the call is stopped or the read fails.

    • readSse

      private static String readSse(InputStream in, CompletableFuture<?> call, GrokLlmService.DeltaSink sink) throws Exception
      The readSse method reads server-sent lines until data: [DONE]. delta.content is kind c and is appended. reasoning_content is not read. A cancelled HTTP future throws GrokLlmService.CallStopped.
      Parameters:
      in - The stream is the response body.
      call - The future is the HTTP call.
      sink - The sink receives each content chunk. A null sink drops the text.
      Returns:
      The return value is the joined content.
      Throws:
      Exception - The method throws this exception for a bad shape, a transport failure, or a stopped call.

    • emitContent

      private static void emitContent(GrokLlmService.DeltaSink sink, StringBuilder joined, com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.JsonNode node) throws Exception
      The emitContent method appends one content chunk. A null node or a JSON null returns. A node that is not text throws an exception with the message llama content shape. An empty string returns.
      Parameters:
      sink - The sink receives kind c. A null sink drops the text.
      joined - The builder holds the joined reply text.
      node - The node is delta.content.
      Throws:
      Exception - The method throws this exception when the node is not text or the sink stops the read.
